opening.argument: The material is a warning against BitConnectX, not an invitation to invest. Its title calls BitConnectX a “Cryptocurrency RipOff 2.0,” and the discussion describes the proposal as requiring people to put more money into a new product after acquiring BitConnect tokens. The speaker directly cautions viewers, asking, “Do you want to scam? Because that's how you get a scam.” It also warns that similar staking scams may follow and predicts that the BitConnectX market will be heavily dumped. The website and event footage therefore serve to explain and criticize the third-party scheme, while the requested viewer response is avoidance rather than participation.
